metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Like Clueless, this is an iconic teen comedy with sharp wit, memorable quotes, and a fun high school setting.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Perfect for fans of Clueless, offering an empowering, stylish, and highly comedic story about proving everyone wrong.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Matches the clever teen-comedy vibe of 10 Things I Hate About You, featuring a witty, self-aware protagonist.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: Captures the magical adventure of Fantastic Beasts and the witty fantasy charm of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A classic fantasy adventure comedy that perfectly aligns with the playful, heroic spirit of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black, this shares the exact same fast-paced, hilarious buddy-detective dynamic as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: If you're looking forward to Wake Up Dead Man, this clever, star-studded whodunnit delivers the perfect blend of mystery and comedy.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A hilarious and colorful mystery that matches the modern, comedic ensemble vibes of Wake Up Dead Man.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A lighthearted, star-studded heist comedy that captures the breezy, crime-comedy energy of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Shares the cosmic scale, retro soundtrack, and irreverent team-up humor of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: An action-packed, video-game-inspired comedy that matches the high-energy, immersive fun of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: Combines the magical whimsey of Practical Magic with the lighthearted romantic comedy of Clueless.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a fantasy twist that will appeal to fans of Only Yesterday and Practical Magic.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A high-energy, nostalgic teen comedy that matches the vibrant late-90s spirit of Clueless.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Just like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a hilarious modern Shakespeare adaptation filled with teen-comedy antics.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: An absolute blast of a jungle adventure-romance that perfectly hits the comedic tone of Jumanji.

metas.name: Love & Monsters
metas.description: A surprisingly heartwarming adventure that echoes the fun, creature-filled quests of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, visually stunning romantic comedy that matches the quirky, colorful atmosphere of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Whisper of the Heart
metas.description: A peaceful, nostalgic Studio Ghibli romance that perfectly mirrors the gentle feel-good drama of Only Yesterday.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: A visually stunning, high-octane superhero adventure filled with humor and heart, great for fans of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: An action-packed, stylized comedic ride featuring quirky characters and chaotic energy, ideal for fans of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Combines high-energy action, gaming aesthetics, and comedic romance, matching Jumanji and Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: An uplifting, glamorous rom-com that shares the vibrant, stylish, and comforting tone of Clueless.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, sci-fi romantic comedy with a time-loop twist, great for fans of modern comedies with fantasy elements.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The ultimate action-adventure comedy that paved the way for modern fantasy adventures like Jumanji and D&D.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A highly entertaining mystery-comedy with great ensemble chemistry, matching the fun vibes of Wake Up Dead Man.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A highly rewatchable, comedic, and music-filled comfort movie that matches the feel-good energy of A Bad Moms Christmas.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious, action-packed comedy starring Melissa McCarthy that fans of A Bad Moms Christmas and The Nice Guys will love.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A lighthearted superhero movie that matches the playful, body-swap fantasy/action tone of Jumanji.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A breezy, comedic spin on survival adventure that captures the fun group dynamics of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern, hilarious teen comedy about friendship that matches the sharp-witted dialogue of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: A hilarious, fast-paced animated comedy filled with physical humor, perfect for fans of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Death Becomes Her
metas.description: A dark but incredibly campy fantasy-comedy that perfectly matches the supernatural sisterhood vibe of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A whimsical, time-traveling romantic fantasy that will appeal to fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A visually gorgeous, quirky, and fast-paced comedy-mystery that captures the stylistic high-art feel of Nouvelle Vague.

metas.name: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
metas.description: The ultimate lighthearted comfort movie about having fun, matching the timeless teen appeal of Clueless.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: A highly entertaining, fast-paced treasure hunt adventure that matches the nostalgic fun of Jumanji.

metas.name: Warm Bodies
metas.description: A unique, lighthearted romance with fantasy elements that captures the quirky charm of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: An iconic, high-energy Jim Carrey comedy that matches the wildly expressive physical humor of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Directed by Taika Waititi, this mockumentary is packed with the same irreverent, brilliant humor seen in Thor: Ragnarok.
